description: List the cards of a deck in order (1-based index, plain front/back text plus frontMd/backMd Markdown source and type). Fetches ALL cards unless limit/offset are given.

limit.description: Max cards to return. Omit (with offset) to fetch ALL cards.

offset.description: 0-based card offset. Omit (with limit) to fetch ALL cards.

name: list_cards
title: List cards
